notes:
Export: Faster H.264 exports on macOS, especially on Macs with multiple video encoding engines.
Transcription: Faster local MOSS transcription on Apple Silicon through pipelined and batched decoding; batching may produce small differences in wording, punctuation or segment boundaries.
Codex: Handle closed input pipes and wait for process cleanup when connections fail.
Audio timing: Fixed audio starting early after seeking in exports, transcription, analysis and footage processing, including previously cut files. ALAC stream-copy timing can still differ by a fraction of a packet.
Requirements and verification limits: macOS requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+. Windows packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; GPU variants require compatible drivers. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies. Electron 44.9.3 embeds Node 24.22.0 and does not include the October Node security fixes. Automated release checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, or paid agent calls.
